# MossyMesh

> Decentralized offline compute mesh. Phones, Raspberry Pis, PCs, and LoRa radios form a censorship-resistant, identity-routed grid with deterministic WASM jobs and a ≤10 MB edge ledger.

Website: https://mossymesh.com
Repository: https://github.com/movahedi-ca/MossyMesh
OpenAPI: https://mossymesh.com/openapi.yaml
API index: https://mossymesh.com/api/
Machine-readable project: https://mossymesh.com/api/v1/project.json

## Brand

- Product brand: **MossyMesh** (domain mossymesh.com)
- Chess PoC name: **MessyMash** (offline chess app proving cross-device determinism; ~836 Mnps is a design target, not a measured result)

## SLAs

- Active ledger on edge: ≤ 10 MB RAM
- Unverifiable outputs: < 1%
- Job timeout (unstable RF): < 5% (target)
- No centralized DNS / fixed IP / cloud DB as control plane
- Capacity target: 100 RVCH/day per 20-node island, zero upstream internet (RVCH = Resilient Verifiable Compute-Hours)

## Architecture layers (eight Rust crates; status: wired = runs, partial = real code with mocks, target = design goal)

- mesh-transport (wired): libp2p Kademlia DHT, Ed25519 identity, LoRa CSMA/CA, BLE, STUN-less UDP hole punching. No QUIC, no Reticulum.
- consensus (partial): custom Merkle trie over Blake3, YATA-inspired CRDT merge, LRU eviction. Recursive folding prover is a mock; nova-snark unwired.
- engine (wired): Rust, shakmaty bitboards, wasm32-wasip1 build path
- sandbox (partial): wasm32-wasip1, WASI, static INT8 quantization, hard 10 MiB guest heap (MEM_LIMIT). Native WAMR behind a feature flag; pure-Rust host runs tests today.
- interop (partial): Axum gateway, WebSocket sync with exponential backoff, HTLC escrows, TWAMM (2% max spread). VDF-delayed cancel is a mock.
- governance (partial): Web of Trust onboarding, quadratic staking, 3-of-5 admin multisig decaying to zero over 90 days, ZK-blinded voting
- ai (wired): SITF tensors, Edge PagedAttention, Vulkan Compute (CPU backend is the real path)
- integration (wired): cross-crate smoke harness running the real offline pipeline end to end
- frontend (wired): TypeScript PWA, captive portal
- Sybil defense: Wesolowski VDF over RSA-2048 (replaced MinRoot in issue #199); 50,000,000 sequential steps, ~10 min burn, millisecond verification

## Roadmap phases

1. Transport: offline Wi-Fi, captive portal, LoRa/Kademlia
2. Sandbox: 10 MB cap, Wesolowski VDF job DIDs
3. Consensus: trie ledger, SNARK proofs, CRDT island merge
4. Logic: WASM chess engine, HTLC escrow
5. Interop: OpenAPI gateway, TWAMM (2% max spread), liquidity bridge
